labels.annexes_blurb: The detail behind the summary figures

funnel.caption: Share expressed against sessions over the period.

captions.trend: Daily revenue, taxes and shipping included.
captions.sales_detail: Net sales = gross sales - discounts - returns. Total sales adds shipping and taxes. For discounts and refunds the change is measured on the amount: a negative percentage means fewer discounts or fewer returns.
captions.sources: Shopify last-click attribution. Orders with no identified referrer are grouped under direct.
captions.channels: Only the online store channel feeds the traffic and conversion figures in this report. Other channels appear in sales but not in the funnel.
captions.categories: Product lines come from Shopify's product type field. Products with no type set do not appear.
captions.variants: Ranked by gross sales over the period, across all product lines.
captions.sales_country: Country taken from the order's billing address. It does not necessarily match the country of the visit.
captions.top_products: Share calculated on total gross sales for the period. This table totals less than gross sales as soon as the catalogue is larger than the products listed.
captions.inventory: Sell-through = units sold against stock available over the period. A product at zero at period end may have been out of stock before the month ended.
captions.returns: Amounts shown as absolute values. A refund is dated when it was processed, not when the original order was placed.
captions.traffic: A session is a visit that ends after 30 minutes of inactivity, measured on the online store only.
captions.margin: Gross profit deducts neither shipping costs, nor payment fees, nor advertising spend.
captions.plan: Targets aim at a level the store has already reached in the last six months. When that level is too old to serve as a target, the goal is capped at a three-tenths improvement. Gains are calculated at the period's volume.
captions.follow_up: Milestone: the first monthly step of the plan set last month. A missed milestone says nothing about the cause.

priorities.returns_finding: {amount} refunded over the period, or {rate} of gross sales, about {annual} over twelve months at the current rate.
priorities.returns_goal: Bring the refund rate down to {target}
priorities.conversion_finding: {rate} conversion over the period, against {target} in the best of the last six months.
priorities.conversion_note: Gain estimated at constant traffic ({sessions} sessions) and constant average order value ({aov}).
priorities.margin_finding: {rate} gross margin, against {ref} over the reference period.
priorities.basket_finding: {value} average order value, against {ref} over the reference period.
priorities.source_note: At constant revenue on that source, this means growing the rest from {current} to {goal} per month.
priorities.concentration_finding: Three products make {share} of gross sales.
priorities.concentration_goal: Bring the top three share down to {target}
priorities.concentration_note: At constant sales on those three products, this means growing the rest of the catalogue from {current} to {goal} per month.
priorities.ref_best_six: best level of the last six months
priorities.ref_capped: three tenths better than today, the best month in the window being too old to serve as a target
priorities.ref_convention: a one-fifth reduction, for want of usable history

methodology.plan_text: Workstreams are ranked by the amount they represent. Targets take a level the store has already reached in the last six months, and gains are calculated at the period's volume. No cause is put forward.
